first_round_test
script:
# ===================================================== # First Round Interview – Consolidated Scheduler Email # (ONLY LATEST RECORD / NO DUPLICATE EMAIL) # ===================================================== frappe.log_error( "Running First Round Interview Scheduler", "First Round Schedule" ) # ------------------------------------------------- # Fetch ALL First Round Interviews # ------------------------------------------------- all_interviews = frappe.get_all( "Interview", filters={ "interview_round": "First Round" }, fields=[ "name", "job_applicant", "scheduled_on", "from_time", "modified", "custom_meeting_link", "custom_location" ], order_by="modified desc" ) # ------------------------------------------------- # Keep ONLY latest interview per candidate # ------------------------------------------------- seen_candidates = set() interviews = [] for row in all_interviews: if row.job_applicant not in seen_candidates: interviews.append(row) seen_candidates.add(row.job_applicant) if not interviews: frappe.log_error( "No First Round interviews found", "First Round Schedule" ) # ------------------------------------------------- # Group interviews by interviewer # ------------------------------------------------- interviewer_map = {} for interview in interviews: interview_doc = frappe.get_doc("Interview", interview.name) for row in interview_doc.interview_details: if not row.interviewer: continue interviewer_map.setdefault( row.interviewer, [] ).append(interview_doc) # ------------------------------------------------- # Process each interviewer # ------------------------------------------------- for interviewer_email, interview_docs in interviewer_map.items(): rows_html = [] attachments = [] sr_no = 1 for doc in interview_docs: applicant = frappe.db.get_value( "Job Applicant", doc.job_applicant, ["applicant_name", "email_id", "designation"], as_dict=True ) if not applicant: continue candidate_name = applicant.applicant_name candidate_email = applicant.email_id designation = applicant.designation or "Position" interview_date = frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.scheduled_on) from_time = doc.from_time meeting_link = doc.custom_meeting_link or "" meeting_link_html = ( f'{meeting_link}' if meeting_link else "Not Shared Yet" ) location = doc.custom_location or "Not Mentioned" # ------------------------------------------------- # Candidate Email (ONLY ONCE / LATEST RECORD) # ------------------------------------------------- if candidate_email: candidate_message = f"""

Dear {candidate_name},

Greetings from Vaaman Engineer (India) Ltd!!!

As discussed, please join the First Round interview on {interview_date} at {from_time}.

Google Meet Link:
{meeting_link_html}


Regards,
HR Team

""" frappe.sendmail( recipients=[candidate_email], subject=f"Interview Schedule – First Round ({doc.name})", message=candidate_message, delayed=False ) # ------------------------------------------------- # Resume Attachment # ------------------------------------------------- resume_file = frappe.db.get_value( "File", { "attached_to_doctype": "Job Applicant", "attached_to_name": doc.job_applicant }, ["file_name", "file_url"], order_by="creation desc", as_dict=True ) if resume_file: attachments.append({ "file_url": resume_file.file_url }) # ------------------------------------------------- # Interviewer Table Row # ------------------------------------------------- rows_html.append(f""" {sr_no} {candidate_name} {designation} {interview_date} {from_time} {meeting_link_html} {location} """) sr_no += 1 # ------------------------------------------------- # Interviewer Email # ------------------------------------------------- base_url = frappe.db.get_single_value("ATS Settings", "host_name") or frappe.utils.get_url() feedback_link = f"{base_url}/candidate-feedback" interviewer_message = f"""

Dear Sir,

Please find below the interview schedule for First Round.

{''.join(rows_html)}
Sr No Candidate Name Designation Date Time Google Meet Link Location

Candidate Feedback Link:
{feedback_link}


Regards,
HR Team

""" frappe.sendmail( recipients=[interviewer_email], subject=f"Interview Schedule – First Round ({sr_no - 1} Candidates)", message=interviewer_message, attachments=attachments, delayed=False ) frappe.log_error( f"Interviewer mail sent to {interviewer_email}", "First Round Schedule" )

name: Send Referral Approval Email
script:
if doc.is_employee_referral == 1 and doc.employee_referral_email: nextjs_base_url = "https://www.vaaman.in/" approval_link = f"{nextjs_base_url}/api/approve-referral?applicantId={doc.name}&token={doc.referral_token}" reject_link = f"{nextjs_base_url}/api/approve-referral?applicantId={doc.name}&token={doc.referral_token}&action=reject" email_content = f"""

Referral Approval Request

Hello,

Candidate {doc.applicant_name} has submitted a job application and added you as a reference.

Please click below to confirm the referral:

Approve Referral Reject Referral

If you do not know this candidate, please reject this email.

""" frappe.sendmail( recipients=[doc.employee_referral_email], subject=f"Action Required: Approve Referral for {doc.applicant_name}", message=email_content, delayed=False )

name: Job Offer Auto Attachment
script:
# Generate PDF from Print Format
pdf = frappe.get_print(
    "Job Offer",
    doc.name,
    print_format="Offer Letter with Annexure",
    as_pdf=True
)

# File Name
file_name = f"{doc.name}.pdf"

# Create Attachment
file_doc = frappe.get_doc({
    "doctype": "File",
    "file_name": file_name,
    "attached_to_doctype": "Job Offer",
    "attached_to_name": doc.name,
    "content": pdf,
    "is_private": 0
})

file_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

Google Meet Link:
{meeting_link_html}


Regards,

Dear Sir,

Please find below the interview schedule for Second Round.

{''.join(rows_html)}
Sr No Candidate Name Designation Date Time Google Meet Link Location

Candidate Feedback Link:
{feedback_link}


Regards,
HR Team

""" frappe.sendmail( recipients=[interviewer_email], subject=f"Interview Schedule – Second Round ({sr_no - 1} Candidates)", message=interviewer_message, attachments=attachments, delayed=False ) frappe.log_error( f"Second Round interviewer mail sent to {interviewer_email}", "Second Round Schedule" )
